test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 29 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A alone can do a work in 20 days, B alone in 30 days. They work together for 6 days, then A leaves. How many more days will B take to finish the remaining work?
solution:
**Given:**

A time = 20 days

B time = 30 days

Working together = 6 days

**Formula Used:**

Work rate = 1 ÷ Time

Total work = Sum of individual works

**Calculation:**

⇒ LCM of 20 and 30 = 60

⇒ Rate A = 3 ÷ 60

⇒ Rate B = 2 ÷ 60

⇒ Combined rate = (3 + 2) ÷ 60 = 5 ÷ 60

⇒ Work done in 6 days = 5 ÷ 60 × 6 = 30 ÷ 60

⇒ Remaining work = 60 ÷ 60 − 30 ÷ 60 = 30 ÷ 60

⇒ Time taken by B = (30 ÷ 60) ÷ (2 ÷ 60)

⇒ Time taken by B = 30 ÷ 2

⇒ Time taken by B = 15 days

**∴ The correct answer is 15 days.**
